method: Parsed 2023 JEC elected-only original PDF pp.26-37, all 52 province headings recognized (3 province name-order aliases), 350 name lines, compared province-wise NFKD normalized exact strings with official Interior XLSX 2023 rows read with artifact_tool. Inspected conflicting original page 33 and Barcelona page 27 (partial; additional page with Barcelona continuation captured via text). Never assumed equal labels imply immutable longitudinal person identity.

four_exceptions_no_names.summary: Interior includes M DEL CARMEN; JEC listed CARMEN. A later Congreso roster also lists CARMEN surname label. Plausible same person but no immutable ID crosswalk; classified contextual probable not exact.
Original JEC has alternative familiar name in parentheses; Interior XLSX omits it. Normalize carefully without dropping meaningful legal names.
JEC elected-list entry includes a parenthetical note about a renunciation and succession; Interior elected-row name does not include note. This is editorial context, not extra legal name.
pdftotext interleaves/garbles a given name across line and margin; visual PDF page 33 displays full name unambiguously, matching Interior field.

H1: SUPPORTED in bounded contextual sense: all 350 records have a compatible partner by 2023 province; 346 strict exact after normalizing accents/punctuation, four nonexact explained but not algorithmically identity-certified.
H0: No substantive conflicting seat observed within 350 extracted records; not proof no latent publisher errors.
ABR: Original independent coverage for elected name roster improved; never population person identity accuracy or historical publication timing.
ABP: Use editorial-note and alias-aware quarantine; no forced automatic merge for four exceptions. Keep source-specific title/name and independent review fields.
C10_preexposed: Albacete and Salamanca were checked first, remainder expanded under C11 prereg; not blind independent replication.
R5: Further name normalization experiments on same 350 would be overfitting; use fixed error-class tests instead.
next: C12 implement source-authored minimal fail-closed QA script/regression tests for sentinel and date invariants; stop if no new discriminating original data.
